name: @kashscript/floor
description: The floor as tests: a scanner and a small runtime that check a repository against the floor.manifest.json it keeps — no route lists, searches or looks up persons; no score, rank, rating or count of a person; no price for issuing, holding, presenting or checking a record, and no percentage; no per-person declined state; every exported count through suppress at k = 5; every decision naming its rule version; every mounted route declared. Each failure names the decision it enforces. Apache-2.0.

scripts.test: bun run typecheck:test && bun test && bun run build && node test/node-smoke.mjs
